question: Does post-launch actor feedback help or hurt chest-impact recovery in source and newly trained policies, after accounting for quiet stability under the same held-command intervention?
intervention: Hold each world's final pre-launch actor command from just before 5 seconds through 12 seconds; retain the reference target conversion, local PD, delays and all physics. Six actors: two source seeds plus both matched endpoints. Each actor receives quiet, +X and -X conditions on native and GPU, eight poses each.
admission: Native prefix must match its sealed live-feedback baseline through the held command within 1e-10; GPU uses the already locked unchanged-replay calibration envelope, without widening. Replay each actual pre-hold observation through its actor; require the post-hold command to be exactly constant. Require backend outcome/contact agreement.
decision: Interpret impact-specific feedback effects only for actors that retain all quiet held-command cases. Report changes in hit impulses as part of the complete-encounter intervention. Any failed prefix/backend admission remains rejected. No learning or promotion.
